Switchbacks. Container canyons. Quayside speed.

ADVANCED

Read the route

Container corridors, switchbacks and a fast quayside.

Find time

Set the entry speed before each switchback. Leave room for the next direction change; a spectacular angle is expensive if it leaves you facing a wall.

Practise here

Bank a controlled slide, then build a new one through the next corner.

Try Vintage Racer and LOCK.
